# shadow-skill

Lint fixture whose arguments use a non-canonical spelling of bbox.

### Arguments
- `--input`, `-i` — input Zarr.
- `--output`, `-o` — output Zarr.
- `--date` — canonical date flag.
- `-b` — non-canonical bbox spelling (should fire WSK101).
- `--period` — a legitimate one-off flag.
